name: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. makes and sells steel products in Japan, Europe, Asia and elsewhere. Its range includes steel building materials such as H-beams, I-beams, sheet piles, deformed bars and square steel pipes that are cold rolled, and steel plate products such as hot coils, pickling coils, galvanized coils and cut sheets. It dates from 1934 and has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
